claim: Patchline ships a grand-unified, one-command evidence index proving novelty, rigor, autonomy, adoption, and reproducibility. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the one-command claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make grand-unified-one-command-index-gate`.
